description: Source code for snapshot and screenshot matchers in Playwright testing framework, including functions for snapshot comparison, screenshot handling, and related utilities.

classes.name: SnapshotHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing snapshot and screenshot comparison, including file paths, comparison results, and handling mismatches.

methods.name: toMatchSnapshot
methods.description: Function to compare a received buffer or string against a stored snapshot, with support for updating snapshots.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshot
methods.description: Function to compare a page or locator screenshot against a stored expected screenshot, with options for updating and diffing.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshotStepTitle
methods.description: Utility to generate a step title for screenshot assertions based on provided name or options.
